extraction.Name: Ida Houston Roubideaux
extraction.NOTES: Received patent by mail while living at Wood; has been sick a long time and does not remember signing a receipt; husband was living at the time and took care of these matters; sold land in 1918 for $3600.00, paid in full in cash at one time; no debts settled at time of sale; document notarized by E. E. McKean, Superintendent, April 4, 1929
extraction.Literate/Illiterate: I have had no education and can neither read nor write.
